title: Making threes
notes: Keep one adult at each table; the youngest adult can read and help record while children choose tiles. On return, K-1 can partition the nine tiles (P2), build no-three collections (P3), or collect triples through one tile (P4). Grades 2-3 can use P4-5 for incidence and fixed game length after the rule is secure. Grades 4-5 can separate the maximum proof (P2), all partitions (P4), and no-early-stopping proof (P5). Retain all deeper arguments; the two-attribute check remains a readiness check, not a reported classroom result.
